title: ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32752v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. translated_title: ActionRAG：面向大语言模型智能体长期记忆的证据精炼图扩散方法
translated_abstract: LLM智能体需要能够从不断增长的交互历史中恢复精确且相互一致的证据的长期记忆，尤其是当答案依赖于事实之间的关系而非孤立的语义匹配时。当前的记忆流水线在两个阶段仍然脆弱：索引错误可能碎片化重复的实体或将不同实体错误合并，而在线检索常常将初始相似度分数视为最终结果，即使周围的图结构提供了修正这些分数的证据。我们提出ActionRAG，一种将谨慎索引与查询时图回溯评估相结合的图记忆架构。其索引流水线对类型标签进行协调并应用分层实体消解。给定查询后，双通道的实体与三元组检索形成初始证据集，并诱导出一个有界的局部图。查询条件下的接收者归一化扩散利用局部路径结构来精炼三元组分数。种子保护、枢纽惩罚通量……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ActionRAG提出了一种图记忆架构，通过谨慎的分层实体消解索引与查询时基于局部路径结构的图扩散回溯评估，帮助LLM智能体从长期交互历史中恢复精确且相互一致的关系型证据。
en_tdlr: ActionRAG is a graph memory architecture that couples cautious tiered entity-resolution indexing with query-conditioned graph diffusion retroevaluation, enabling LLM agents to recover precise and mutually consistent relational evidence from long-term interaction histories.
